race.comment: SUPER WONDER (3) has been given a let-up since dropping out over this course and distance six weeks ago. Led all the way for an arrogant win over 1000m at the Parks circuit the run prior. A strong recent trial win suggests he is going to set the record straight today. OLE GO (1) is the class runner back from a 24-week spell. Led and just failed to hold out Verzain first-up last prep in the Listed Without Fear over this track and trip. Toyed with his rivals in a trial here on 28 September. Can win despite the 61kgs. OUR BRAVE BOY (5) was backed as though unbeatable first-up at Murray Bridge but ran into some dead-ends and probably should have won. Promising three-year-old who draws a lovely gate and should be right in the thick of things. CZECH OUT (2) came wide and finished too well over 1000m at Murray Bridge recently. Competitive with Verzain last prep which ties in well with OLE GO. AZYTASS (6) is consistent and has placed at both runs here at today's trip.
